exactCriterion: Catégories et compteurs exacts, aucun ID dupliqué.
checks: All IDs loaded from all 28 production JSON files; global uniqueness.
Every category/status/priority and source/dependency reference is valid.
Exact category and status counters recomputed from every record.
Every generated runtime ID, work, name, category, status and catalogue digest agrees with current JSON.
Every input byte hash rechecked after enumeration.
limits: Actual current catalogue/registry verification, with no status editing or workbook generation.
Counts measure tracked records, not completed missions, original-game likeness or artistic fidelity.
Native workbook/counter verification and product browser journeys remain separate evidence.
